notes: This sample preserves upstream identity for Epic 32 adaptation work.
The compose shape is derived from the official pgAdmin container deployment documentation; the Websoft9 docker-library entry is used as a secondary reference only.
pgAdmin is a stateless web client for external PostgreSQL servers and has no built-in database.
The Websoft9 reference includes a throwaway postgres container for testing; it is intentionally omitted from the normalized template.
The first pass stores source metadata rather than a full upstream file mirror.
